title: Powerlifting
hook: This week's data is from Open Powerlifting. Wikipedia has many details around the sport itself, as well as more details around the 3 lifts (squat, bench, and deadlift). Credit to Nichole Monhait for sharing this fantastic open dataset. Please note this is a small subset of the data limited to IPF (International Powerlifting Federation) events, the full dataset with many more columns and alternative events can be found as a .csv at The full dataset has many more federations, ages, and meet types but is >250 MB.
